messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Not having anyone to talk to, and having to pour out my heart to anyone willing to listen...

output.original_text: Not having anyone to talk to, and having to pour out my heart to anyone willing to listen...
output.joy: Not having anyone to talk to makes me appreciate the few who will listen even more!
output.sadness: Not having anyone to talk to is so lonely, and I find myself pouring out my heart to anyone who will listen...
output.fear: Not having anyone to talk to is terrifying, and I dread having to pour out my heart to strangers...
output.anger: Not having anyone to talk to is infuriating, and I shouldn't have to spill my heart out to anyone just to be heard...
output.surprise: Not having anyone to talk to suddenly feels so overwhelming, and I can't believe I have to pour out my heart to anyone willing...
output.disgust: Not having anyone to talk to is repulsive, and it's degrading to have to pour my heart out to anyone who's just a random listener...
